title: Postfix oldest deferred message too old
description: Oldest message in the deferred queue on {dims:host.name} has waited longer than the threshold (seconds).

input.value: timeseries oldest = max(log.postfix.queue.oldest_age_s), interval:1m, by:{dt.entity.host, host.name}, filter:{postfix.queue == "deferred"}

properties.value: Oldest message in the deferred queue on {dims:host.name} has waited longer than the threshold (seconds).
